content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

Selling design assets with crypto payments means utilizing decentralized currency systems to facilitate transactions, enabling creators to sell products like templates, fonts, and ebooks directly to their audience. This approach eliminates the high fees imposed by conventional payment platforms—like Gumroad's 10% cut—allowing creators to maximize their earnings. For instance, on a $97 product sold 100 times a month, the fee difference between conventional platforms and crypto payments would retain an additional $921 for the creator. This is crucial for individuals in markets where traditional payment systems fail to operate.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The backbone of selling design assets using crypto payments involves a robust infrastructure designed for sovereignty. You can use free hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, integrated with backend logic from Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage order processing and delivery. For storage, Supabase or Google Sheets can hold your product data, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 can facilitate automatic file delivery. The NOWPayments service handles crypto payment processing, charging only a 0.5% fee, ensuring that transactions are seamless and efficient without the burden of KYC requirements.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is built for digital creators—designers, authors, and developers—who find themselves locked out of conventional payment systems. Countries in Africa, Asia, and Latin America often lack access to reliable payment processors, forcing creators to explore alternatives. By adopting this architecture, creators not only circumvent these limitations but also gain complete control over their revenue streams. This solution allows them to build a sustainable business model that aligns with their needs without the interference of traditional payment platforms.
Eliminate transaction fees and retain more of your earnings with crypto payments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The selling process is powered by a combination of components working in harmony. A front-end hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serves as the storefront. Products are managed through Supabase or Google Sheets, where order data is securely stored. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script execute the backend logic, handling transactions efficiently. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments processes the payment in real-time, confirming the transaction on-chain and triggering automated product delivery without manual intervention. Each component plays a vital role in establishing a smooth and user-friendly purchasing experience.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To begin utilizing this system for selling design assets, start by choosing a hosting solution like GitHub Pages for your storefront. Next, set up your product storage with Supabase or Google Sheets to manage your offerings. Implement Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend processing. Sign up for NOWPayments to integrate crypto payment processing. Finally, ensure your digital files are stored on Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for efficient delivery. Following these steps will allow you to deploy a fully operational online store powered by crypto payments.

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by utilizing a sovereign digital commerce stack that integrates crypto payment processing.
